scripts.build:mobile: npm run build:css && npm run prepare:capacitor-web && npx cap sync
scripts.build:apk:debug: npm run build:mobile && node -e "const { execSync } = require('child_process'); execSync(process.platform === 'win32' ? '.\\gradlew.bat assembleDebug' : './gradlew assembleDebug', { cwd: 'android', stdio: 'inherit' });"
scripts.build:apk:release: npm run build:mobile && node -e "const { execSync } = require('child_process'); execSync(process.platform === 'win32' ? '.\\gradlew.bat assembleRelease' : './gradlew assembleRelease', { cwd: 'android', stdio: 'inherit' });"
scripts.build:aab: npm run build:mobile && node -e "const { execSync } = require('child_process'); execSync(process.platform === 'win32' ? '.\\gradlew.bat bundleRelease' : './gradlew bundleRelease', { cwd: 'android', stdio: 'inherit' });"
scripts.emulator: node -e "const { spawn } = require('child_process'); const p = process.env.LOCALAPPDATA + '\\Android\\Sdk\\emulator\\emulator.exe'; spawn(p, ['-avd', 'medium_phone'], { detached: true, stdio: 'ignore' }).unref(); console.log('Emulator launching in GUI window...');"
scripts.android:run: npm run build:apk:debug && node -e "const { execSync } = require('child_process'); const adb = process.env.LOCALAPPDATA + '\\Android\\Sdk\\platform-tools\\adb.exe'; execSync(`\"${adb}\" install -r android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk`, { stdio: 'inherit' }); execSync(`\"${adb}\" shell am start -S -n com.trenscends.travelplanner/.MainActivity`, { stdio: 'inherit' });"
